blocks.text: RESOURCES / GEO CHECKLIST
FREE GEO CHECKLIST.
Get your brand cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. 30 checkpoints for 2026.
BRAND PRESENCE & ENTITY SETUP
Wikipedia or Wikidata entity page (if applicable)
LinkedIn company page fully completed
Google Business Profile claimed and optimised
Crunchbase or similar business profile
Consistent NAP across all directories
Official website clearly states: who you are, what you do, and who you serve
CONTENT FOR AI CITATION
Clear, factual 'About' page that AI can summarise
Dedicated pages for each service/product with structured content
FAQ sections with direct, quotable answers
Statistics and data points cited (with sources)
Original research or data you can own
Author bios with credentials and real expertise signals
Case studies with specific, verifiable metrics
SCHEMA & STRUCTURED DATA
Organisation schema on all pages
FAQPage schema on FAQ content
Article schema on blog posts
LocalBusiness schema (if applicable)
Person schema for author pages
Review/Rating schema where appropriate
THIRD-PARTY MENTIONS & AUTHORITY
Featured in or mentioned by reputable publications
Press releases distributed to industry media
Guest posts on authoritative sites in your niche
Podcast appearances (AI often cites podcast transcripts)
Forum and community contributions (Reddit, Quora, industry groups)
Mentions on .edu or .gov domains
AI SEARCH MONITORING
Track brand mentions in ChatGPT (manual testing)
Monitor Perplexity citations for branded queries
Set up alerts for brand + competitor queries in AI tools
Check Google AI Overviews for your target keywords
Review accuracy of AI-generated summaries about your brand
